title.zh: 路死觀察典藏・公開子集

description.en: Citizen-science roadkill observations from the released 2011–2017 TaiRON archive. Each point is a generalized 10 km grid-cell centre.
description.zh: 取自臺灣路死觀察網 2011–2017 公開典藏的公民科學紀錄。每個點皆為概化後的 10 公里網格中心。

limitation.en: Published subset dates: 2014-01-02–2017-12-31. Conservation metadata checked for 15,600 of 18,147 Least Concern records. Conservative subset: only exact-name GBIF Least Concern matches screened against published terrestrial and marine protected lists. Fuzzy taxon matches, marine turtles/mammals, seabird groups, sea snakes and bats are omitted conservatively; this screen is not a legal status determination. Exact coordinates, observer details and individual source links are withheld. Map points are 10 km cell centres, not observation locations; multiple records may share a centre. Source coordinate accuracy is unknown; the 7.1 km generalization radius describes the grid only. Counts reflect reporting effort, not animal abundance or roadkill risk.
limitation.zh: 公開子集日期：2014-01-02–2017-12-31；已核對 15,600／18,147 筆無危紀錄的保育資訊。採保守公開子集：僅呈現學名完全符合的 GBIF 無危紀錄，並以公開陸域及海洋保育名錄篩檢。模糊分類匹配、海龜、海洋哺乳類、海鳥分類群、海蛇及蝙蝠皆保守排除；本篩檢不是法律上的保育等級認定。精確座標、觀察者及個別來源連結不公開。地圖點位是 10 公里網格中心，並非發現位置，多筆紀錄可能共用中心。來源座標準確度未知，7.1 公里概化半徑僅描述網格。通報數受觀察投入影響，不代表動物數量或路死風險。

title.zh: 臺灣路死觀察網・提供觀察紀錄

description.en: Use the official network to contribute new observations. EcoAtlas does not collect user submissions in this release.
description.zh: 請透過官方觀察網提供新紀錄；本版 EcoAtlas 不收集使用者通報。

description.en: Taiwan Biodiversity Research Institute, TaiBIF and GBIF. Lin T (2026), version 1.11, DOI 10.15468/cidkqi.
description.zh: 農業部生物多樣性研究所、TaiBIF 與 GBIF；Lin T（2026），版本 1.11，DOI 10.15468/cidkqi。

title.zh: 官方陸域保育類野生動物名錄

description.en: The currently published list is used only for a conservative exclusion screen. This atlas is not a legal status determination.
description.zh: 以官方目前公布的名錄進行保守排除；本圖集不作法律上的保育等級認定。

title.zh: 官方海洋保育類野生動物名錄

description.en: The published marine list supplements the terrestrial screen. Sensitive marine groups are conservatively omitted even where an individual legal status is uncertain.
description.zh: 以公開海洋名錄補足陸域篩檢；海洋敏感分類群即使個別法律等級未確認，亦保守排除。
